declarations.name: AuiHoverCard
declarations.description: AbsoluteUI Hover Card on its trigger: `Ada...`. The template is rendered as an embedded view, so its bindings stay live.

inputs.name: hoverCardPlacement
inputs.description: Preferred side and logical alignment; flips and shifts to fit.

inputs.name: hoverCardShowDelay
inputs.description: Delay before showing on hover or keyboard focus, ms. 0 shows synchronously.

inputs.name: hoverCardHideDelay
inputs.description: Grace period after the pointer leaves trigger and card before hiding, ms. Always asynchronous, so the pointer can move onto the card.

inputs.name: hoverCardDescribe
inputs.description: The trigger references the card with aria-describedby (added to existing ids). Set false for long or highly interactive cards.

outputs.name: opened
outputs.description: After the card became visible (dispatched on the card element).

outputs.name: closed
outputs.description: After the card was hidden. 'programmatic' covers hide(), destroy(), and another hover card showing.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Show the card now (without the hover delay).

accessibility.pattern: Supplementary preview disclosed on hover or keyboard focus, meeting WCAG 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus; the card is a generic container in DOM order right after the trigger (not a dialog, not a tooltip).

limitations: Touch pointers never show the card; it must not hold essential information or actions.
Keyboard focus uses the same showDelay as hover (default 600 ms); focus from a pointer click (not :focus-visible) does not show it.
Only one hover card is visible at a time per loaded copy of the module.
The card is inserted immediately after the trigger, so it inherits the trigger's container styles; a trigger inside inline text puts a div into that inline context.
With describe true (default), screen readers read the whole card text as the trigger's description; set describe false for long or highly interactive cards.
The gap between trigger and card is fixed at 8px. The close animation is not played.
